boundary_rules: A software test is not an experimental observation.
Repeated numbers or matching plots do not promote a hypothesis.
8 Hz is a reference coordinate unless an independent physical measurement establishes otherwise.
SUNET/SND are infrastructure/provenance layers, not physics validators.
ArXiv preprints are sources of research claims; peer-review status must be tracked separately.
coverage_note: This map covers the repository's major functional surfaces and all currently mapped UPI evidence layers. It is not a claim that every individual source file has been semantically audited line-by-line.
